problem: For integers r>=2, k>=1, a_1..a_k>=1, b>=1 let P(q) = [a_1]_q...[a_k]_q * [b]_{q^r}, where [n]_q = 1+q+...+q^{n-1} and [b]_{q^r} = 1+q^r+...+q^{r(b-1)}. P is (weakly) unimodal if its coefficients satisfy c_0<=...<=c_m>=...>=c_N for some m. U = {b : P unimodal}, F = sum floor(a_i/r), D = sum(a_i-1). Question: exactly which parameters make P unimodal? (Source: arXiv:2605.12822, Conjecture 5.4.)

passed.statement: (literature, arXiv:2605.12822 Cor. 4.3; reproved) r | a_i for some i => P symmetric unimodal.
For all r>=2, k>=1: b <= 1 + sum floor(a_i/r) => P symmetric and weakly unimodal (sufficiency half of Conj. 5.4).
r=3, no a_i divisible by 3: P unimodal iff b <= 1 + F + 2*floor(S/6), F=sum floor(a_i/3), S=#{a_i=2 mod 3}.
passed.basis: 已证明 (two independent proofs, both ACCEPT)

passed.statement: Exact (non-closed-form) criterion, three equivalent forms: E2 Theorem A (d_u = coeffs of p(q)(1-q)/(1-q^r), tau = r-periodic tail; unimodal iff E_u >= d_{K-u} for K/2<u<=D+1-r, K=D+1-r(b+1)); E5 Theorem 1 (c_n - c_{n-1} = e(n-r(b-1)) - e(D+1-n), e(y)=Gamma_{y mod r} - H(y-r), H = coeffs of A(q)/[r]_q); E7 Theorem 5 (unimodal iff g_i >= g_{i-rb} for 0<=i<=floor(N/2), G = prod[a_i]_q/[r]_q).
At most three a_i >= 2, r divides no a_i: P unimodal => b <= 1 + sum floor(a_i/r) (necessity clause of Conj 5.4 for k<=3, every r).
r=2, all a_i odd: P unimodal => b <= 1 + sum floor(a_i/2). With T1: r=2 completely decided.

General r, r divides no a_i: P unimodal => b <= 1 + floor((D+1-2mu)/r), mu = least t in 0..r-1 with Gamma_t >= ... >= Gamma_{r-1}, Gamma = residue-class sums mod r of coefficients of prod[a_i]_q (only residues a_i mod r matter). Equivalent Fourier form E2 Theorem B; E7 Cor 10.
Non-existence: unimodality is not a function of (r,k,b, multiset of a_i mod r, F, D): r=6, b=4, a=(2,3,4,4,4,4,4,8) unimodal, a'=(2,2,3,4,4,4,4,10) not.
Computer-assisted: r<=6 and at most three a_i with residue outside {0,1} mod r => necessity (b <= 1+F).
Unimodality not monotone in b: r=6, a=(2,3,3,4,4,4,5) unimodal at b=1,3 not at 2,4; exactly 133 such (r,a) in box r<=6,k<=8,a_i<=12,b<=60, all r=6, k in {7,8}.
passed.basis: 有限范围计算 (2 reviewers PASS)

passed.statement: In box r<=6,k<=8,a_i<=12: all 7,761,685 instances with b<=1+F unimodal (consistent with T1).
passed.basis: 有限范围计算 (2 reviewers PASS)

passed.statement: Round-1 synthesis results (synthesis proof ACCEPTED by referee): E6 = floor((D+1-2mu)/r) - F is even and >= 0 (Lemma 7); {1..1+F} c U c {1..1+F+E6}; flat domain (at most two middle residues, residue in [2,r-2]): U = {1..1+F+E6} exactly (Thm E); peeling: U(a + r e_i) contains {1} and 1+U(a) (Thm B); large-part regime: U = [1,F] u (F+U_inf), U_inf depends only on r and the residue vector (B4).

(R2E1) Thread criterion: P_b unimodal iff for every residue thread V_b>=0 and V_{b-1}+d_b>=0, with a parity split (Theorem 12). Consequences: S2(i): if b in U and b == F (mod 2) then b+1 in U; max U == 1+F (mod 2) when r divides no a_i; step-2 closure: b in U, b>=3 => b-2 in U (no hypothesis on r|a_i); U finite iff r divides no a_i (Thm 15); conditional Thm 17: if at the first off-parity failure the inequality L' (d_j - d_{j+1} >= d_{j+3}) holds then B* <= B_off + 3, i.e. S2.
passed.basis: 已证明 (referee ACCEPT; z3 for bounded induction steps; ~300k cases 0 mismatch)

passed.statement: (R2E2) Theorem R: S2 follows from three finite residue-level conditions TP_rho, E_rho, O_rho on the small-part instance rho (parts = residues < r); part sizes never matter (lifting). Lemma 10: b > 1+floor((2y*-D-1)/r) => not unimodal, y* = least y with d_y<0. The certificate holds for all 3,154,273 residue multisets swept (r=2..30, k up to 40 for r<=5 down to 4 for r=28..30, plus equal residues k<=60); referee reproduced the count.
passed.basis: 已证明 (reduction, referee ACCEPT) + 有限范围计算 (certificate sweep, reproduced by referee)

passed.statement: (R2E3) Structure theorem: if r divides no a_i, U = [1,sigma] u {sigma+2, sigma+4, ..., tau*-2} with sigma == tau* == 1+F (mod 2), tau* >= sigma+2; hence S2 <=> tau* <= sigma+4. Lemma 7: residue-class sums of prod[a_i]_q are cyclically unimodal peaked at S/2 (statement to be read on the coset S/2+Z).

(R2E5) Window Lemma: P unimodal iff tau_m + g_{K-m} - g_m >= 0 for the r integers m with K/2-r <= m < K/2. Sandwich theorem for all-equal a=nr+s, middle s: E(0) c E(1) c ... and E(n)=E_inf once 2(nr+s) > k(s-1)+1-r. With finite certification: U([nr+s]^k) = [1,kn+1] u (kn+1+E_inf) for all n>=1, 4<=r<=30, 3<=k<=60. Parity structure of E_inf (two chains: odd e <= E_odd, even e <= E_even, E_odd < E_even) proved for all r>=4, middle s, k>=3.
passed.basis: 已证明 (referee ACCEPT; finite part reproduced)

passed.statement: (R2E6) Sandwich window for E = B*-1-F from M = max tau (Thm 1/Cor 1, needs a_min >= 2n_lo+2r); explicit bounds on M via L_k = max_j sum_i ln|sin(pi j s_i/r)/sin(pi j/r)| (Thm 2); growth order (Thm 3): fixed r and residue proportions with positive middle mass, k->infinity, a_min large: |E - (c k - ln k/(r lambda))| <= C2 with c = (sigma1 - 2 theta*)/r, 0 < c < sigma1/r (Lemma 6). So the excess is linear in k.
(R2E7) Explicit L0 = max(1, floor((S-k+3-r)/2)) (S = sum(a_i-1)) for the large-part regime; universal necessity U(a) c [1,F+1] u (F+U_inf); two-chain structure of U_inf; U_inf c [1, T6-F].

(R2E8) r>=4, r divides no a_i, exactly three a_i with middle residue, nm = #{a_i == -1 mod r}: if r<=30 and nm<=37 then U = [1,B*] with B* = T6 - 2*[tau_s<=-2 and s>=2mu], s=(D+1) mod r, T6 = 1+floor((D+1-2mu)/r).
passed.basis: 已证明 (computer-assisted, referee ACCEPT, finite part recomputed independently)

passed.statement: S2 holds on all 100,488 multisets r in [4,8], 1<=k<=6, a_i in [2,2r+2], r dividing no a_i; B_main-B_off = 1 in 100,402 and 3 in 86. Reviewer A also found 0 violations on ~553k new instances (k to 11, a_i to 4r, r 9..14).

holdout_summary:
Current conjectures (not proved):
- S2 (round-1 synthesis, open): if r divides no a_i, U = {1..B*} or {1..B*} minus {B*-1}, B* == 1+F (mod 2). After round 2: S2(i), step-2 closure and the parity of max U are PROVED (T9, T11). What remains is exactly the odd shift b -> b-3 (equivalently B_off >= B*-3, equivalently tau* <= sigma+4 in T11, equivalently the residue certificate TP/E/O of T10 for every rho).
- Three-middle closed form T15 beyond r<=30 or nm<=37 (0 errors on hidden holdout H4 incl. k up to 100).
- Cyclic unimodality of prod[rho_i] mod (q^r-1) as a route to TP/E/O (0 failures in test_cyclic_unimodal.py, unproved).

Hidden holdouts (explorers never saw them). Round-1 holdout: 5,600 (r,a) full b-profiles, 309,455 instances, r up to 15, k up to 24, a_i up to 60. Round-2 holdout: 2,000 (r,a), 37,766 instances near the threshold, r up to 29 (incl. 14,17,19,22,23,26,29), k up to 60, a_i up to 100.
Results (errors = instance errors; FP = predicted unimodal but not; FN = predicted not but unimodal):
- Exact criteria T3 (E2_exact, E5 exact_e, E7 exact): R1 0/309,455; R2 0/37,766.
- r=3 rule (T2) implementations: R1 0; R2 0.
- E5 'flat residue' closed form: domain max_t|Gamma_t-Gamma_{t+1}|<=1 (always for r<=3 and when every a_i = +-1 mod r), unimodal iff b <= 1+floor((D+1-2mu)/r): R1 0/247,004; R2 0/12,540. Free params 0. Upper-bound half = T6 (proved); lower half unproved. 1 reviewer PASS.
- E2 closed form for r<=3 or <=3 nontrivial factors: R1 0/210,083, R2 0/6,340 (derivable from T1,T2,T4,T5; derivation under review).
- E3 lookup table on (residue multiset of nontrivial factors, multiset of small a_i): 2,001 params; R1 0/54,180 (in its domain), R2 0/510.
- T6 bound as an iff: R1 990 FP, 0 FN; R2 2,393 FP, 0 FN (it is only necessary).
- T1 as an iff: R1 5,390 FN, 0 FP; R2 10,403 FN, 0 FP (only sufficient).
- Monotone threshold rules (E2_threshold, E7_threshold): R1 10 FP = exactly the 10 non-monotone (r,a) in R1 holdout -> 拟合表.
- E5 'window' rule (fixed window of pairs): R1 16 errors (r=7,9, k=20, all a_i equal) -> 拟合表.
Excess statistics in the box (E5, unreviewed): B* - 1 - F is always 0, 2 or 4 for r<=6, k<=8.
N_collision count: the tie-break reviewer confirmed 43 inconsistent aggregate keys in the box; the witness pair is verified (T7).
Round-3 holdout H3 (hidden; 43,239 instances, larger r and k): round-1 synthesis rule 0/43,239; exact criteria (E2_exact, E5_exact) 0; r=3 rule 0; E4 (one-sided, FN only) and E2_residue (FP only) consistent with their one-sided claims.
Round-4 holdout H4 (hidden from round-2 explorers; 1,270 (r,a) tuples, 51,858 (instance,b) pairs; strata: r in {2,3} with k 91-140; r 4-12 with k 91-140, a_i<=250; r in {61..120} with k 10-40, a_i<=400; three middle residues r 7-24, k 41-100; all-equal middle residue r 4-14, k 91-150; many small parts r 13-30; residues near r/2, k 91-140). b window [B0-5, T6+2] plus random b.
- Round-1 synthesis rule: 0/51,858. R2E1 thread criterion: 0/51,858. R2E2 residue-certificate rule (s3star): 0/51,858.
- R2E5 all-equal rule: 0/10,293 (its domain). R2E8 three-middle rule: 0/7,897 (domain; includes nm far above 37).

failures:
- E4 candidate C0 (one factor [a_i][b]_{q^r} unimodal times rest): fails 567,349 / 7,761,685 target instances. C1 (each Lambda chain good on its own): fails 5,732,481. C3 (one-step transfer identity, k=2): fails 270/1,586.
- E1: H=(p-rho)/Phi_3 unimodal: false for 574/12,853 products; symmetrised e-delta/2 unimodal: false for 536.
- E2: first-harmonic approximation of tau: 31,387 errors in box.
- E5: windows of pairs M-x < r+J with J=0,1,2: 20,321 / 4,237 / 245 errors in box; J=max(0,r-3) has 0 in box but 16 holdout errors at r=7,9,k=20.
- Rules depending only on (r,k,b,residue multiset,F,D): impossible (T7); in box 43 inconsistent keys claimed (count 43 confirmed by tie-break reviewer).
- E3 feature search: 5,927 subsets of a 33-feature library tried (sizes 0-3); smallest determining feature sets involve the multiset of small a_i together with residues; no aggregate-only set works.

ROUND 2 failure records: read the file /tmp/claude-0/qu/explore2/failure_only.txt (verbatim explorer failure reports, R2E1-R2E8). Key items: the only open step of S2 is the odd shift b -> b-3 (B_off >= B*-3); inequality L' fails abstractly (d=(2,1,1,1,1,1); 82/8659 abstract sequences), so quantitative product structure is needed; the k-independent strong residue certificate fails for 25,737/1,547,599 long rho'; single-part induction on the certificate loses parity bookkeeping; (Z2) A_{s0+2}+E_{s0+4}<0 is the missing step in the T11 route and fails for generic symmetric/log-concave A (102/2312, 226/10859); 'U_inf is one of three shapes' is FALSE (r=10, k=40, T=15, U_inf=[1,11]; 270/3000); L0 is not sharp and the sharp threshold is not residue-only; asymptotic fits C11/C3 fail on H4 (142/172 errors); no S2 counterexample in ~659M evaluations (R2E4).

- UNREFEREED, AI-assisted (status: claimed proofs, 待核): GitHub VladimirReshetnikov/ProveIt (Sept 18-20 2026): Thm 3.2 sufficiency for every r (centered peeling identity [a]_q[b]_{q^r} = [a+r(b-1)]_q + q^r[a-r]_q[b-1]_{q^r}); Thm 4.2 necessary bound b <= 1+floor(S/r) (S=sum(a_i-1)) when r divides no a_i; Thm 5.1 r=2 complete; Thm 6.1 r=3 complete (b <= 1+Q+2 floor(t/6)); Thm 7.1 (1+q)^n(1+q^r) unimodal iff n >= r^2-3; Prop 8.1 minimum-degree counterexample to necessity is unique (r=3,b=2,a=2^6).
